g.text: SDD v2 — Proposed same-origin extension authentication relay (D51 review)
open relay page after normal sign-in
[Stop, navigation, tab close, sign-out or failure]
The extension receives no cookie, bearer token or reusable API credential.
An unpaired extension, non-app origin or replayed nonce is refused.
Proposed design: team SDD/security approval is required before implementation
The same-origin page owns the authenticated WebSocket; the extension only relays captured audio
